claims.statement: Committed ctrl-gen.c explicitly names ctrl-gen.py def as its generation source and contains a shared generated prologue.
GETTER_TEMPLATE and SETTER_TEMPLATE are embedded in the fixed Python file and gen_ctrl formats them using control metadata; no separate template is read in this examined generator.

The generator accepts -i/--input and reads supplied YAML files with SafeLoader. inputs starts empty; the generated header shorthand supplies no input, so it is not a complete reconstruction recipe. standard-units.yaml is an observed matching input candidate in the same tree, not a proven historical invocation.

The examined CMakeLists.txt compiles committed src/ctrl-gen.c as a base source and links LibUSB. It does not declare a ctrl-gen.py/standard-units generation rule; this is a statement about this file, not every possible build path.

The JPEG branch is conditional in CMake; it can add frame-mjpeg.c and link JPEG::JPEG. Source and actual selected JPEG implementation must be inventoried separately. DISABLE_JPEG is not permission to remove a required capture format.

frame-mjpeg.c carries Robert Xiao 2014 BSD three-clause text, a default Huffman-table source attribution, and uses jpeglib/JCS_EXT_BGR. Those facts do not identify the selected linked JPEG distribution or close its notices.
